Alarm.com demonstrates genuine operating leverage with margin expansion from 6.1% to 13.2% and strong cash generation at 13.6% FCF margin, supported by a fortress balance sheet with $960.6M in cash after settling $500.0M in debt. However, three factors warrant caution before deeper diligence: management's explicit acknowledgment of limited revenue visibility due to partner-dependent demand generation creates forecasting uncertainty; aggressive acquisition activity with five deals in 2025 including $77.2M for RGS obscures organic performance; and 95% North America concentration leaves limited geographic diversification. The declining software license revenue stream and year-over-year operating cash flow drop from $206.4M to $153.3M despite operating income growth add to concerns about underlying business quality. The partner-dependent model and integration execution risk make this a 'Watch' rather than 'Dig deeper' until organic metrics and cash conversion stabilize.
